blocks.text: Baby lips quenched: everyday go-to for moisture underneath your favorite Maybelline lipstick. Baby lips Dr. Rescue: a sheer lip tint that combats dry and chapped lips while treating over time. Baby lips cherry Me: moisturizes while bringing the perfect shine to your attention-grabbing kisser. Use throughout the day or apply at night for a hydrating overnight lip mask.
